fact: The document says the management information system completed in January 2016 supported integrated social safety nets, naming the Child Grants Programme, the OVC Bursary and Public Assistance; this is the date given in the document for the system, with the programme list as the document's own examples.
system: Management Information System for Social Assistance (MISSA) / NISSA social registry
source_slug: 2024-01-01 Lesotho — RFP for NISSA social registry and MISSA

fact: UNICEF reports the tablet-based digital birth registration system under the Ntlafatsa Bana project, launched at Ha-Tankele, is integrated with NISSA, Lesotho's national social assistance database, in real time.

The ministry says it is working with the National Identity and Civil Registry (Ministry of Home Affairs) to establish an interoperability link with NISSA/MISSA, and a consultancy is sought to develop and test the API between them.
